name: Backend Multi-Step Lifecycle Instrumentation & Audit Trail Queries
requirements: Define SwitchAuditSteps, SwitchBackupStep, SwitchResetStep, SwitchRestoreStep, SwitchVerificationStep, InstanceSwitchRecord, and InstanceSwitchHistoryResponse in task_history_db.rs
Implement get_instance_switch_history and get_instance_audit_trail functions querying tasks and hot_tasks_cache with instance_id filter
Instrument switch_account_to_instance in instance.rs to record the 4 explicit steps: backup (projects, counts), reset (PIDs, auth swap), restore (injection, method), verification (post-restore check)
Fix default instance audit tracking so instance_id is recorded as 'default' rather than empty and AuditTask is never dropped with false failure
Register get_instance_switch_history and get_instance_audit_trail in commands/instance.rs and lib.rs
